name.en: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)

summary: Financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefits: See the official guidelines for the current scholarship rates.

Not availing benefit of any other scholarship scheme s including State run scholarship schemes/ fee waiver & reimbursement scheme
